title: Reject impossible calibration verification dates
prompt:
Reject impossible dates in lib/ohworks-calibration-verification.ts. Its isUtcTimestamp helper at lines 186-187 relies on Date.parse normalization. Lines 308-316 accept lastVerifiedAt and asOf through that helper, and lines 327-330 do the same for trigger events. Verified reproduction: lastVerifiedAt 2026-02-30T00:00:00Z, maxIntervalDays 30, no triggers, and asOf 2026-03-03T00:00:00Z returns CURRENT/interval-current with dueAt April 1. The instrument readiness view uses this evaluator at lib/ohworks-demo-instrument-readiness-view.ts:83, feeding app/pilot/ohworks/instrument/page.tsx:20.

Strengthen only the module-local predicate to check real UTC ISO calendar and clock fields before accepting parsed timestamps. Support valid Z timestamps with and without fractional seconds. Return the existing OVERDUE failure result with null dueAt and the appropriate last-verification-timestamp-invalid, as-of-timestamp-invalid, or trigger-event-timestamp-invalid reason. Preserve event priority, interval arithmetic, warning thresholds, missing-verification handling, and valid-input behavior. Do not alter the calibrator-certificate module or other date helpers.

Add tests/ohworks/verification-schedule-calendar-dates.test.ts covering impossible dates separately in all three positions, non-leap February 29, April 31, invalid clock fields, and valid leap-day controls. Assert exact decisions, reasons, and null due dates on rejected input. Run node --import tsx --test tests/ohworks/verification-schedule-calendar-dates.test.ts tests/ohworks/calibration-verification.test.ts tests/ohworks/demo-instrument-readiness-view.test.ts. Use fabricated records; work on the assigned branch you are on. Edit only the named production file and new test. No credentials, deploys, sends, payments, migrations, workflows, package.json, auth changes, commits, or pushes.
